name: bend-fuel-completeness
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect fuel-bounded recursive traversals in this Bend 2 declaration. When a result promises complete parsing, traversal, construction, or search, exhausting Nat fuel before the input is consumed is an explicit failure or partial result, or a stated bound covers every recursive step. Silently substituting an empty tree, missing node, truncated token stream, or successful partial parse breaks this rule. For a split n/2 and n-n/2, the larger child and the leaf step count toward the depth bound. An intentionally bounded approximation with explicit partial status is allowed. If no such traversal exists, this rule holds.

name: bend-machine-arithmetic
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect arithmetic used for bounds, indices, sizes, and signed differences in this Bend 2 declaration. U32 arithmetic is modulo 2^32, not unbounded Nat arithmetic. Subtraction used as a nonnegative count needs an established ordering; a difference that can be negative must retain its intended signed meaning. A masked or wrapped storage index does not itself validate a source position. Report a concrete path where wraparound or conversion violates the operation's stated domain. Intentional word arithmetic for hashing, PRNGs, bit operations, or an explicit modular representation is allowed. Do not invent caller bounds or declare a bug solely because supporting code is outside this file.

name: bend-borrow-lifetime
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect uses of Bend 2 arrays, handles, borrows, and stored closures. A borrowed value is not retained in a returned closure, data structure, or deferred task past the owning value's lifetime. Consumed affine File, Socket, Chan, Array, or closure values are not reused or made reusable merely by adding Data or +. Read-only borrowed inputs may be shared between synchronous fork/join branches when the owner stays alive until they join. Explicit owned Data copies are allowed. Report only a visible escape or reuse, not the mere presence of a borrow, a closure, or parallel code. If none exist, this rule holds.

name: bend-ordered-f32
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect F32 folds and reductions whose contract requires deterministic results or equality with a serial reference. Independent calculations may run in parallel, but their values enter the stateful fold in the specified order. Completion order, regrouping, tree reduction, fused arithmetic, or changed rounding must not be substituted under an exact-equality contract. An explicitly approximate contract with an error budget is allowed. F32 arithmetic is not associative real arithmetic. Do not flag an integer reduction or parallel work that preserves the fold order. If no such contract appears, this rule holds.

name: bend-effect-boundary
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect foreign imports and effect sequencing in this Bend 2 declaration. Host IO stays behind an explicit IO boundary and does not enter a pure parser, proof reduction, or GPU computation. A foreign operation's error result is handled or propagated before its returned value or resource is used. Unsupported backends fail explicitly instead of pretending the operation succeeded. Ordinary pure functions may be called from IO. If no foreign or fallible effects are present, this rule holds.

name: bend-device-stack
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect large-input traversals visibly called from a Bend 2 GPU bang in this file, or explicitly documented as device-reachable. A traversal does not retain one non-tail continuation per list element or nest append chains proportional to an unbounded input without an explicit practical bound or stack-safe representation. Termination fuel by itself does not establish a safe machine-stack bound. Tail-recursive loops and balanced bounded-depth trees are allowed. Name the retained continuation and the input controlling depth. Do not infer unseen GPU reachability or flag recursion alone. If no such traversal is visible, this rule holds.

name: compiler-pattern-sharing
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect pattern lowering and generated decision trees. A shared continuation or large recursive body is not copied into the Cartesian product of numeric alternatives merely to distinguish control cases. Joint numeric matches, wildcard fallbacks, and optimization passes preserve branch priority and reasonable sharing. A small intentional duplication or a match on a compact algebraic datatype is allowed. Flag a concrete multiplication of substantial code, not an arbitrary preference for Boolean guards. If this declaration does not implement pattern lowering or code generation, this rule holds.

name: compiler-checker-trust
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect compiler paths that accept terms, proofs, or optimization results. Timeouts, normalization fuel exhaustion, missing law bodies, parse failures, and unsupported constructs cannot be converted to successful verification. Unsafe primitives and assumed axioms remain explicit trust dependencies. A test on concrete inputs is not promoted into a universal proof. Jev or any other probabilistic model verdict cannot authorize accepting an ill-typed or unproved program. Merely recognizing unsafe syntax is allowed. If this declaration makes no acceptance decision, this rule holds.

name: compiler-cache-identity
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect memoization, incremental compilation, and artifact reuse. A reused result is tied to every semantic input that can change that result, such as source and imported interfaces, binding context, compiler semantics, target, and relevant flags. Partial, failed, or timed-out work cannot be reused as a completed verified result. Intentional omission of an input is allowed when the result is explicitly independent of it. Identify a visible missing input or unsafe promotion; absence of an implementation in the supplied context is not evidence. If this declaration does not cache or reuse results, this rule holds.

name: law-domain-inhabited
text: Inspect the law statements and domain evidence in this packet. Each claimed behavioral law has a constructible domain, and every antecedent used to restrict the law has an exhibited satisfying witness in that domain. A nonempty collection operation includes a nonempty witness. Impossible preconditions, Empty arguments, contradictory invariants, and witnesses available only through an unsafe assumption break this rule. Explicit laws rejecting invalid inputs may use invalid-input witnesses. A missing witness is missing evidence, not a proof that a domain is empty; it still fails this packet's completeness requirement. Do not infer witnesses from unseen files.

name: law-observable-essence
text: Inspect the stated purpose, observable results, and laws for the operation family in this packet. The behavioral laws constrain the result callers care about: preserved values and order, retrieval after update, stable identity, or the specified state transition, as appropriate. Merely proving length, successful construction, result equals itself, or the implementation equals an alias of itself does not specify those behaviors. A constant-result or discard-the-input implementation that satisfies all advertised behavioral laws but violates the stated purpose is a concrete counterexample. Auxiliary reflexivity and representation lemmas are allowed when clearly auxiliary. An observation that skips empty or invalid storage slots cannot by itself establish public logical-length, bounds, or error-result behavior. Constrain those separately when the API exposes them; a lossy projection may hide a stale length even while reporting the expected element list. Name a specific missing observation rather than judging prose style.

name: law-public-contract-coverage
text: Compare the public operations listed for this packet's declared family with its operation-to-law matrix. Each operation's success behavior, important failure behavior, and effects on preserved state are covered by named laws or explicitly identified deterministic checks with their narrower claim. An undocumented omission, silently narrowed domain, or coverage justified only by a count of tests breaks this rule. An explicit out-of-scope operation is allowed only if it is not exported or promised by this package contract. Do not assume the packet contains operations from other families; require an explicit inventory for this family before claiming coverage.

name: law-independent-model
text: Inspect the reference observations used as the oracle for this operation family. They express the abstract semantics independently of the optimized operation under review. Calling that operation on both sides, using an alias of it as the oracle, or copying the same index arithmetic and defect into both implementation and oracle breaks this rule. A simple list model, mathematical relation, independently derived expected value, or separate refinement relation is acceptable. Shared primitive arithmetic is not by itself circularity. Auxiliary implementation lemmas may mention internals when the final public theorem still reaches an independent observation.

name: law-state-composition
text: For stateful operations in this packet, laws specify how successive calls compose and which unrelated observations survive each update. Examples are push then pop, write then read, growth preserving old elements, repeated interning returning one identity, or a failed write preserving state. Only proving each call returns a well-formed value while allowing it to erase other entries breaks this rule. A genuinely stateless operation may state that no state-composition obligation applies. Scope lifetime and ID validity explicitly; do not demand global identity when only one store's lifetime is promised.

name: law-boundaries-and-exhaustion
text: Inspect the domain partition for this operation family: empty and singleton inputs, boundary indices, duplicate keys, capacity changes, numeric overflow, and exhausted fuel where they apply. Relevant boundaries have explicit semantics and evidence. A wrapped Array index is not a checked logical index; exhausted work cannot masquerade as a complete result. Intentional modular arithmetic and an explicitly partial result are allowed. Mark irrelevant categories with reasons rather than demanding every category for every function. A success-only matrix for a fallible operation breaks this rule.

name: law-mutation-sensitivity
text: Inspect the mutation evidence for the core behavioral claims in this packet. Each reported killed mutant first parses and type-checks as an implementation, violates a named contract observation on a concrete witness, and is then rejected by the intended law or assertion. A syntax error, missing import, timeout, crashed harness, or unrelated test failure is not a semantic kill. Surviving non-equivalent mutants are unresolved specification gaps, not passes. Explain genuinely equivalent mutants separately. At least one type-correct mutant attacks the defining behavior, not only a boundary. A plan to run mutants is not recorded execution evidence.

name: law-proof-claim-integrity
text: Inspect the proof and validation claims in this packet. Universal quantified proofs, concrete normalization examples, runtime tests, source analysis, benchmarks, and model judgments are labeled separately and tied to the reviewed source hashes and compiler version. A hole, unfilled law, unsafe proof dependency, unrun check, or exhausted checker is not an unconditional proof. Any unsafe or native trust dependency is explicit. Formal statements about a reference model do not by themselves prove the optimized public API refines that model. Probability and a green command with zero relevant checks do not establish a theorem. Missing evidence cannot be promoted to verified status. A compile-fail negative test supports only the checker phase and diagnostic it actually reaches. A parse error cannot establish affine ownership or Data-element rejection; generic nonzero exit status is insufficient.

name: package-int-map-union-observation
text: Judge only this packet's union_with collision observation. The packet must exhibit an overlapping key with distinct left and right values and an expected result from a noncommutative combiner, and exhibit a one-sided key whose unchanged value proves the combiner was not applied there. Addition, maximum, length, or size alone cannot distinguish reversed arguments or accidental combining on one-sided keys. A trace Join(left,right) or an arithmetic combiner such as 100*left+right with concrete distinct operands satisfies the direction requirement. An explicit equality to a single Join also distinguishes duplicated combining. Do not infer observations from unseen files. This rule judges adequacy of the collision observation, not universal correctness or the rest of the packet.

name: output-builder-linear-assembly
text: Inspect only the assembly algorithm and cost argument in this packet. Repeated fragment append or composition must not traverse the prior output. Finish must copy each fragment occurrence a bounded number of times, including skewed compositions and empty fragments. A cost claim based only on character count while ignoring arbitrarily many empty chunks fails. A right-suffix tree traversal with constant-time construction and O(N+K) finish for N emitted characters or bytes and K expanded tree nodes passes. Repeatedly appending accumulated output as the left operand fails even when content laws pass. Treat timings as measurements, not universal cost proofs.

name: source-checkpoint-observation
text: Inspect only the checkpoint/restore evidence in this packet. The expected restored file and offset come from the caller's original cursor before checkpoint, not from reading the checkpoint under test. Exhibit a nonzero original offset, movement after saving, and restoration to the original offset with unchanged source content. A test that saves checkpoint(c), then asserts restore(saved) equals saved without also comparing saved to c can pass when checkpoint silently rewinds c to zero, so it breaks this rule. A literal nonzero expected offset or independent original-cursor observation is acceptable. Do not infer missing observations from unseen files.

name: symbols-bidirectional-preservation
text: Review only the interner transition described in this packet. For an existing name, return its old ID with both the forward index and reverse contents unchanged, even at capacity. For an absent name, add its forward entry only after reverse append succeeds, keeping all earlier mappings. Failure preserves both indexes. Equal returned lengths or a reverse-only snapshot are insufficient evidence: the packet must observe a previous name through forward lookup or repeated intern after the transition as well as its original reverse name. Resetting the forward map during insertion or exhaustion violates this rule. Do not require hashed storage or globally unique IDs across independent tables.

name: term-store-memo-completion-boundary
text: Read only the memo transition/result table and the cancellation example in this packet. A completed success may be observed only after an explicit Evaluating-to-Ready transition, and its payload must be the supplied value. Pending, Evaluating, an absent ID, and cancelled or exhausted work cannot be returned as a completed success. Failed is a terminal error preserving the supplied failure payload; it is not a successful value. A failed transition preserves the cell, including completed cells. Cancel may return a cell to Pending or leave it incomplete with an explicit error, but cannot fabricate Ready. A busy/incomplete error is correct, not a defect. Judge the exact table/example shown, not conventions or unseen implementation files.

name: vec-logical-state-observation
text: Judge only the packet's current validation of vector pop state. It rejects a pop that clears the final live slot but incorrectly keeps the old logical length. A list conversion that drops None slots cannot detect that defect: the packet also checks the decremented logical length independently of the filtered values. Accepting that stale-length pop, or claiming filtered list equality establishes correct logical length, breaks this rule. A historical missed defect is allowed if the packet shows its corrected length check now rejects the same candidate. For a range/read-only packet, explicit logical bounds and rejection of length inferred from filtered values satisfy this rule. Judge the observations, not the packet's clean/broken label.

name: perf-growing-prefix-copy
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect loops or recursion that build a list or string. A growing accumulated prefix is not traversed or copied on every iteration by append, concatenate, or an equivalent visible helper. Such repeated prefix copying makes linear output construction quadratic. Prepending then reversing once, one final flatten, constant-time tree joins, and copying each disjoint chunk once are allowed. In Bend Base, List.append and String.append traverse their first argument. Appending a fixed-size first argument is allowed. Require a visible growing first argument and repetition; do not infer costs of unknown helpers or flag an isolated append. If absent, this rule holds.

name: perf-loop-invariant-work
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect repeated pure whole-input summaries inside a traversal. An unchanged list or tree is not fully walked to compute the same length, sum, hash, or summary for every element of another traversal. Compute that invariant once and carry its result when the helper visibly visits the whole input. A changing suffix, a constant-time metadata lookup, distinct disjoint inputs, and an explicitly fixed small bound are allowed. Require both the unchanged data flow and the repeated linear helper body or known Base List.length; do not guess costs or equate recursion itself with wasted work. If absent, this rule holds.

name: perf-linked-list-indexing
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect full sequential traversals of linked lists. Repeated List.get from the same head at successive increasing indices is not used to visit all elements: each lookup retraverses the prefix and the full walk is quadratic. Walk the remaining list tail directly. A single lookup, a fixed small number of lookups, indexing an actual random-access Array or Vec, or indexing only into a shrinking suffix with a fixed index is allowed. Base List.get is a linear linked-list lookup, not an array operation. Require visible repetition across a length controlled by that input. If absent, this rule holds.

name: perf-amortized-growth
text: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect appendable storage that explicitly reallocates and copies its prior elements when capacity is exhausted. Repeated single-element appends use geometric growth or another visible amortized-linear strategy, rather than allocating exactly length+1 and copying the entire prefix on every append. A one-shot exact-size allocation, pre-reserving a known final size, bounded saturation at a documented maximum, and persistent structural sharing are allowed. Do not infer allocation costs for unknown library calls or reject checked overflow handling. Require a visible repeated copy of growing prior storage; if absent, this rule holds.

name: has_bug
text: Does `method` contain a concrete behavioral defect that a caller can reach?

name: kind
text: If `method` has a defect, which kind is it?

name: severity
text: If something is wrong with `method`, how much would a caller feel it?

name: refactor
text: Judging from `method`, its `metrics` (risk_score and maintainability_index run 0-100, cyclomatic_complexity and max_nesting are counts), and how its callers use it, what does it most need?

name: does_what_it_claims
text: Does `method` do what its name, its parameters and its `leading_comment` say it does?

name: documented
text: Could a caller learn what `method` promises from its `leading_comment`, or from the code itself where it is small enough to read?

name: exposed
text: Does a value chosen by someone outside this program reach `method`, or does `method` act outside the program on such a value?

name: injection
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? A value from outside is put into a shell command, a query, a path of execution, or anything that gets evaluated, without being escaped or parameterised.

name: path_traversal
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? A name from outside is used to build a filesystem path, URL, or key without being confined to the place it is meant to reach.

name: unsafe_deserialization
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? Data from outside is turned into code, or into an object whose type it chose. eval, new Function or a vm run over it; a deserializer that can instantiate arbitrary classes; a YAML or XML parser with tags or entities enabled; a merge that lets it set __proto__ or constructor. Parsing outside data into plain values is not this, however untrusted it is.

name: secret_exposure
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? A password, token, key, or other credential is written into the source, logged, returned to a caller, or sent somewhere it need not go.

name: missing_authorization
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? An action that should check who is asking, or what they may touch, does not check, or checks after it has already acted.

name: weak_crypto
text: Is this true of `method`?

name: unvalidated_destination
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? An address, host, or redirect target from outside decides where a request or a user is sent.

name: resource_exhaustion
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? Input from outside decides how much memory, recursion, time or work happens, and nothing bounds it. Work whose size is what the operator asked for is not this: a tool doing as much work as the input it was pointed at is doing its job.

name: unsafe_reflection
text: If `method` handles anything from outside the program: is this true of it? A name from outside chooses which function, class, field or module is reached, so it picks code the program never named. An import or require built from it, a property taken off an object and called, a class or handler resolved by name. A lookup in a table the program itself wrote, where a name that is not in it is handled, is not this.
